name: 婚约争执与家族压力 · V1

parameters.prompt: Original instrumental underscore for a contemporary mature werewolf romance, intimate and restrained rather than epic or horror. D minor, 60 BPM, 4/4. Shared recurring four-note leitmotif D-F-E-A with spacious rests, one quiet statement every four bars. Low cello, sparse felt piano, delicate electronic pulse; leave room for a low male speaking voice. Clean studio music only: no voices, breathing, choir, environmental sound, risers or impacts. A seamless 9-bar 36-second bed. Quiet tight short cello/viola ostinato in eighth-notes, restrained low electronic pulse, four-note motif in low strings. Controlled outside pressure and political confrontation, never action trailer or combat. Stable dynamics, no intro/outro, no percussion hits; continuous texture through boundaries.
